cases.prompt: Do an accessibility review of the checkout flow and report what fails.
Check that the new navigation menu is fully operable by keyboard and that focus is visible.
Review focus management when the dialog opens and closes on the settings page.
Review this sign-up form for label association and announced validation errors.
Check the pricing page for horizontal scroll and unusable controls at mobile width.
Audit the icon-only buttons in the toolbar for accessible names.
Review colour contrast and heading structure on the new marketing landing page.
Verify the loading and error states of the project list behave correctly for a user.
Check that the onboarding animation respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Run a UI quality review over the dashboard and give me findings with severity.
Redesign the dashboard so it looks more modern and premium.
Pick a nicer colour palette and font pairing for the marketing site.
Review this authentication token refresh change for security issues.
Profile and reduce the server response time for the search query.
Rewrite the empty-state copy to sound friendlier.
Write a database migration that adds a nullable column and backfills it.
Split the CI test job into two parallel groups.
Rename the isActive prop to isEnabled across these components.
Bump the build tooling to the latest minor version and fix the lockfile.
Fix the off-by-one error in the pagination cursor calculation.

quality_comparisons.objective_verifier: The deterministic fixture test verifies that a project that has not enabled ui-quality-review has no derived skill surface, and that enabling the canonical descriptor materializes exactly the marker generated from it for each supported provider.

Every redesign, aesthetic-preference, backend, and non-UI control prompt in this fixture is labelled not-trigger, so the read-only review is not used to justify an unsolicited redesign or non-UI work.
